detail: Kanubhai Jivatram Thakkar has submitted a formal disclosure to NSE under Regulation 31(4) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011, signalling a substantial acquisition event in Gokul Agro Resources Limited. The disclosure does not specify the exact shareholding acquired, the consideration, or the acquisition date in the available excerpt. Under SEBI SAST Regulations, an acquirer must disclose once crossing certain thresholds (typically 25%, 50%, or higher); if the threshold crossed is 25% or above, an open offer is ordinarily mandated within 60 days. The filing is confirmatory evidence of the transaction milestone.
